Three [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] of the [[One Sith]] were present at the [[Skirmish on Vendaxa|Battle of Vendaxa]] in [[137 ABY]]. '''One [[Color/Legends|black]]-[[Eye/Legends|eyed]] and [[Hair/Legends|haired]] [[Gender/Legends|male]]''' attempted to assault a dazed [[Cade Skywalker]] when the Sith was killed by [[Marasiah Fel]], but not before he wounded Fel in the process.
